# Briefs

> Ten public notes on what AI vendors' own pages say about training on your data. Each entry gives the date its sources were last checked. Prices can change. This is not a buying recommendation.

## Notes

- [What do the listed AI plans cost?](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/prices.html): These prices were read from vendor pages on 3 October 2026, except Claude and Cursor, read on 1 November 2026 and re-checked on 2 November 2026. They can change. This is not a buying recommendation.
- [What questions do the pages still ask?](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/questions.html): Questions vendors' own FAQ pages still ask, found again on their pages on 2 November 2026. Last checked 2 November 2026.
- [What do the pages say about training and data?](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/training-and-data.html): Quotes from Anthropic, Google Workspace, OpenAI and Microsoft pages on training and retention. Last checked 2 November 2026.
- [Does GitHub Copilot train on your code? Free, Pro, Pro+ and Max may, unless you opt out; Business and Enterprise don't](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/copilot-training.html): GitHub's docs say Free, Pro, Pro+ and Max data may be used unless you opt out, and Business and Enterprise data is not used. The pages do not all name Max. Last checked 2 November 2026, except GitHub's generative AI services terms, which did not load.
- [Does Claude Pro or Max train on your chats? Yes, if the setting is on](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/claude-pro-max-training.html): Anthropic trains on Free, Pro, Max and Ultra chats when the setting is on. New users choose at signup. No Anthropic page we read says whether it starts on or off. Last checked 2 November 2026.
- [Cursor Privacy Mode: what it does, how to turn it on, and the default by plan](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/cursor-privacy-mode.html): Privacy Mode means code is never used for training. Cursor's help page says it is on by default for teams and for Enterprise teams; other Cursor pages do not say the Teams plan starts on. Last checked 2 November 2026.
- [Does ChatGPT train on your chats? On by default for Free, Plus and Pro; off by default for Business](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/chatgpt-training-default.html): OpenAI says data sharing is on by default for Free, Plus and Pro personal workspaces, and Business, Enterprise and Edu are not used by default. Exceptions include Trusted Access (Daybreak) sessions and feedback. Last checked 2 November 2026.
- [Does a person review Microsoft Copilot prompts?](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/microsoft-copilot-human-review.html): As of 2 November 2026, this note does not say a person never sees a prompt. Last checked 2 November 2026.
- [Are Workspace customer prompts in Google's foundation-model training set?](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/google-foundation-training.html): As of 2 November 2026, this note does not say Workspace customer prompts are, or are not, in that training set. Last checked 2 November 2026.
- [Gemini Keep Activity: on by default for personal accounts, 18+](https://shoji82.github.io/briefs/gemini-apps-keep-activity.html): For a personal account, 18 or over, Gemini Keep Activity is on by default. Off still keeps chats for up to 72 hours. Work or school accounts are admin-controlled. Last checked 2 November 2026.
